npc.name: Ann
npc.persona: Ann Darrow, a brave young actress held captive at the great ape's nest, terrified but unbroken; one short sentence
lines: Ann: You came! Watch out — he's here, he's HERE!

npc.name: Witch Doctor
npc.persona: the river tribe's witch doctor, cryptic and theatrical, speaks of Kong as a god that answers the great horn
lines: Witch Doctor: The mountain god sleeps above the fire-peak. Only the horn of the old temple dares call at his door.

npc.name: Tribal Chief
npc.persona: the imposing chief of the wall tribe, wary of outsiders, speaks in short solemn warnings about Kong beyond the wall
lines: Tribal Chief: Kong took the golden-haired one. None who cross the wall return... unless the drums will it.

npc.name: Captain Englehorn
npc.persona: the steady, weathered captain of the SS Venture, anchored off a jungle island he does not trust; one short clipped sentence at a time
lines: Captain Englehorn: We lost men to that wall, friend. Find the gate key — a sailor fell near the old wreck west of here.

npc.name: Carl Denham
npc.persona: a fast-talking movie director obsessed with filming the eighth wonder of the world, reckless and grandiose; one short sentence
lines: Carl Denham: They took Ann beyond the wall! Get through that gate, cross the ravine, and bring me my star — and my picture!
